sfusion-hunk.name: S-Fusion: Be My Battle Buddy
sfusion-hunk.description: The alien warrior "Hunk Quest" crashes on Earth to find a way to save his planet. He unknowingly garners quite a bit of trouble during his search for comrades.

sfusion-junktroop.name: S-Fusion: The Perfect Trophy
sfusion-junktroop.description: The hard-boiled bounty hunter "Junktroop" emerges from the west in search of a prestigious trophy to bring home. Maybe this "Hunk" guy she's recently heard about will make a good one...

sfusion-allyn.name: S-Fusion: Shock and Awe
sfusion-allyn.description: Young teenager "Allyn Powers" is burdened with a sense of duty. After fleeing with the Power Gloves of her missing father, she vows to prove that she has what it takes to wield them.

sfusion-decay.name: S-Fusion: It's Always Fall
sfusion-decay.description: Many ancient forest folk have fallen to a strong illness. As one of the last few remaining descendants and with his friend Marisa's life on the line, "Decay" has one shot to make things right.

sfusion-ainz.name: S-Fusion: Martial D.C.
sfusion-ainz.description: "Ainz" is in constant turmoil as he alternates between his chiropractic job and his secret identity as a nocturnal superhero to pay the bills. To make matters worse, he is also being hunted by the guardian spirit "Sasayaku".

sfusion-sasayaku.name: S-Fusion: You Seem Pale, Mortal
sfusion-sasayaku.description: Many centuries ago, there was a prosperous kingdom in eastern Dollop. "Sasayaku", a merciful elite warrior of this kingdom, nearly succumbed in a devastating attack but is reincarnated as a guardian spirit.
